decisions.decision: The Board did not reach the super-majority needed to support the Contingent Settlement Agreement; K. Chenis said that without a super-majority the Board should not go forward.
decisions.quote: there was not a super-majority vote for the csa.

decisions.decision: The Board agreed that had the new plan been before them initially, they would not have approved it.
decisions.quote: the board was in agreement that if this new plan had been before them initially, they would not have approved it.

decisions.decision: The Board's stated requirement for a settlement, relayed through counsel to opposing counsel: an additional fifty (50') feet of natural trees on all sides.
decisions.quote: the board wants an additional fifty (50') feet of natural trees on all sides

budget_items.what_was_recorded: M. Jeffreys stated he would agree to a $105,000 decommissioning bond provided the project kept fifty feet of existing trees, which Settlers Solar did not do.
budget_items.quote: would agree to $105,000 for the decommissioning bond as long as they stayed with fifty
